text.text_excerpt: This place is heaven. Loved everything I've ever bought from here. The clusters are amazing the pralines are creamy very flavorful and full of pecans. The prices are really reasonable, I have paid more for far less flavor elsewhere. The staff is great and offered me samples when I couldnt decide which flavor to choose. Someone is always cooking a new batch when you walk through the door. The smell of the place is Divine and have often been able to buy warm pralines. They offer both nut and non nut items but who doesn't want nuts barring allergies. I don't visit here often because I'm diabetic but it's worth a taste now and again anyway ! When I have family and friends from out of town THI...

The pralines are creamy and soooooo delicious. It is simply amazing. They melt in your mouth and the recipe never changes. Consistency is always the key for me. I reside in Houston and I never return without at least 5-6 boxes of candy.

Hold up. I am pissed I didn't discover this when I was in New Orleans! I went to the NYCWFF and they had a booth with those amazing Original Pralines with Pecans. I had to take another sample because it was just too amazing. Most pralines I have tried were grainy, but this one is super smooth! Just writing this is pissing me off because I want more. Thanks for visiting New York and showing us how pralines are supposed to be! And thank you for the great hospitality you showed us!
